descriptionMarkdown:
Pyromancer; Universal, Pyromancy; Fire, soul-burning, area denial, purging flame.

Pyromancer; Fire powers deal +1 damage per damage die.

Pyromancer; Creatures damaged by your Pyromancy powers cannot benefit from invisibility until your next turn.

Pyromancer; Once per short rest, your Pyromancy power ignores fire resistance.
